posts.description: Opening weekend is Saturday, September 26. From October on we add Fridays — three full days a week of harvest, right through Sunday, November 1. Pumpkin Village and the U-Pick fields are open every day we are. Every open day runs 10 a.m. – 6 p.m. — gates close at six, every date on the list. Thirty-plus rides and attractions, all covered by one wristband — ride them once or ride them eleven times. Open the RideFinder for height requirements and this weekend’s operating list.

posts.title: A Very Farmy Halloween Edition
posts.headline: 星期六亲子精选
highlights: 近距离喂食高地牛、驯鹿、牦牛、羊驼、马和迷你驴，还能穿万圣节装扮拍照。🌿 可以体验户外与运动主题活动。
posts.description: October only- Halloween costumes (especially farm themed) encouraged! Lots of fall photo opportunities await! This is the only place in the Pacific Northwest where you can pet, feed, and connect with Scottish Highland cows, yaks, reindeer, alpacas, mini donkeys, and horses—all in one unforgettable visit. And yes, our adorable baby calves can’t wait to meet you! More than just a tour, this is your chance to slow down in nature, savor the moment, and create heartwarming memories with majestic animals. Perfect for all ages! Image sourced from event website.

posts.title: Spooky Walk at Snoqualmie Valley Art Center
posts.headline: 星期日亲子精选
highlights: 带上你的南瓜灯，让它在惊悚步行中最后亮一次。结束后南瓜将统一送往农场堆肥。还有免费苹果饮品。
posts.description: Do you ever feel a little bit sad that jack-o-lanterns enjoy such fleeting glory? All of these gourds, grown with care and carved into beautiful folk art, rotting on porches across the land. Hey, guess what? We invite you to bring them out for one final showing. The March of the Vegetables invites you to bring your pumpkin to the Duvall Foundation for the Arts property for one last spooky walk, after which they will be taken to Hearth Farm for composting. November 1. Drop off, anytime after 1:00 PM. Spooky walk from 5-7:30. Free Cider!

posts.headline: 星期六亲子精选
highlights: 🎟️ 活动免费参加。🎨 可以体验艺术与文化主题活动。
posts.description: Top Trumps USA is creating a new, refreshed MONOPOLY: Seattle Edition, debuting in October 2027, and today announced it’s inviting Seattleites to nominate the local places, businesses, and organizations they think best represent the city on the board. Selected spots, businesses, and nonprofits will have the opportunity to become permanent squares on the board, replacing the classic Atlantic City properties with Seattle staples. Public nominations are now open, making this a unique opportunity for local organizations — and a fun question for Seattleites: Which Seattle staples belong on the board? All nominations can be submitted HERE through October 31st.

roundup.title: 本周末亲子活动精选｜7城8场
roundup.caption:
这个周末，7 个城市都有适合家庭的活动！🌿

本周亮点包括「Giant Skulls Day of the Dead Art Exhibit」和「Kid’s Story Time at The Couth Buzzard」，适合安排轻松又充实的亲子时光。从户外探索到社区活动，各个城市都有值得带孩子一起体验的选择。

我们整理了 8 场地区亮点：

- Seattle：Giant Skulls Day of the Dead Art Exhibit
  日期：Saturday, Oct. 31
  地点：Westlake Park · 401 Pine St., Seattle, WA 98101
  亮点：🎟️ 活动免费参加。

- Seattle：Kid’s Story Time at The Couth Buzzard
  日期：Saturday, Oct. 31
  地点：Couth Buzzard, 8310 Greenwood Ave. N. · Couth Buzzard, 8310 Greenwood Ave. N., Seattle, 98103
  亮点：听故事、唱歌、玩游戏，还能一起做合作美术。

- Kenmore：Kenmore Dia de los Muertos Celebration
  日期：Sunday, Nov. 1
  地点：Kenmore Hangar · 6728 NE 181st St, Kenmore, WA 98028
  亮点：第三届 Kenmore 亡灵节庆典，有互动祭坛、表演、趣味活动与手工，带来丰富的文化体验。

- Carnation：Remlinger Farms Fall Harvest Festival
  日期：Saturday, Oct. 31
  地点：Remlinger Farms · 32610 NE 32nd St, Carnation, WA 98014-6104
  亮点：南瓜村与自采南瓜田随园区开放同步开放，30+游乐项目一票畅玩，想刷几遍都行。

- Lake Stevens：A Very Farmy Halloween Edition
  日期：Saturday, Oct. 31
  地点：Luckie Farms · 930 Sunnyside Blvd, Lake Stevens, WA 98258
  亮点：近距离喂食高地牛、驯鹿、牦牛、羊驼、马和迷你驴，还能穿万圣节装扮拍照。

- Auburn：Día de los Muertos Festival at the Outlet Collection
  日期：Saturday, Oct. 31
  地点：The Outlet Collection | Seattle · 1101 Outlet Collection Way, Auburn, WA 98001
  亮点：体验墨西哥亡灵节的多彩传统与社区纪念。

- Duvall：Spooky Walk at Snoqualmie Valley Art Center
  日期：Sunday, Nov. 1
  地点：Snoqualmie Valley Art Center · 14301 Railroad Way NE, Duvall, 98019
  亮点：带上你的南瓜灯，让它在惊悚步行中最后亮一次。

- Pacific Northwest：Nominations Open for MONOPOLY: Seattle Edition
  日期：Saturday, Oct. 31
  地点：Pacific Northwest
  亮点：🎟️ 活动免费参加。

收藏这份周末清单，带上家人一起出门玩吧！
